products.short_description: Unblock a stuck Defender for Office 365 rollout — diagnose the blocker, apply the fix, and get the deployment moving again.
products.description:
Unblock a stuck Defender for Office 365 rollout — diagnose the blocker, apply the fix, and get the deployment moving again.

Deployments stall on the same blockers: mail flow/routing conflicts, policy precedence, Safe Links/Attachments not applying, licensing gaps. This solution is a diagnostic-first playbook for Defender for Office 365 — read-only discovery to pinpoint the blocker, the targeted fix, and verification — so a stalled rollout gets unstuck fast.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Read-only diagnostics to pinpoint the blocker
  • Targeted fixes for the common Defender for Office 365 blockers
  • Onboarding/connectivity/licensing/permission checks
  • Verification that the blocker is cleared
  • Escalation criteria and data to collect for support

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A previously stuck Defender for Office 365 rollout moving again — blocker diagnosed, fixed, and verified, with escalation data if it's a service issue.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TBMMDO-Discovery.ps1 — read-only evaluation-chain snapshot to pinpoint a stalled Defender for
    • TBMMDO-MailFlow.ps1 — read-only mail-routing analysis to spot a Defender for Office 365 routing
    • TBMMDO-Report.ps1 — read-only before/after report proving a Defender for Office 365 blocker cleared
    • TBMMDO-SupportBundle.ps1 — read-only assembly of a support-ready diagnostic bundle for a Defender
    • TBMMDO-Validate.ps1 — read-only pass/fail check that a Defender for Office 365 blocker is cleared

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
